comment: Function reference of the Help page (?p=help#ref-php / #ref-js), rendered by NuFnRef (core/nufnref.php). One entry per line: n name, s signature, g group, d description, r return, e example, o origin (nb = nuBuilder 4.9, next = nuBuilder Next only), v since, k kind (missing = a function of the code: dev/tests/run.php checks that every function of the code has an entry and the other way round; method / hook = documented only). English only.
